---
title: "Rössler Prototype-4 System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y+z\\
\dot{y} &=& ax\\
\dot{z} &=& y+y^2-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-4$ and initial condition $(0,-1,0)$.
